column1: # W49 deletion-approximation cost, 8B OmniGUI.
# WHY. app:method-details concedes in prose that rows cached AFTER a deleted row
# were produced by a causal pass whose prefix still contained the deleted visual
# tokens, so contraction is an approximate state transition, and then states that
# the byte-exact no-op gate is not evidence about the approximation itself. That
# leaves the concession unquantified. GEOPACT_KV_HISTORY_REWRITE=0 falls back to full re-prefill for the
# history prune target (geopact_session_kv._kv_history_rewrite_enabled), i.e. it
# removes the approximation while keeping the same keep set, so the accuracy
# difference isolates exactly the deletion error.
# READING. The rewrite=0 arm is slower by construction; its TTFT is not a
# competitive number and must not be quoted as one. Only the accuracy delta is
# meaningful.
# ANCHORS. Both budgets copy the adopted 8B OmniGUI arms verbatim:
#   mild  (c50/h10) <- w36q_omni_ours.tsv config, adopted as nested_rho05_c50_h10
#   tight (c25/h05) <- w22_omni25_g1.tsv logs/xds8b_tune/omnigui/a2cap_c25_h05
# BENCHMARK|TASK|TRACK|EXP_ARM|RATIO|HIST_N|OUT|LIMIT|EXTRA_ENV
